name: Pressfarm

sources.title: Pressfarm — paid digital PR agency + journalist database; packages incl. Campaign plan $279/yr (feature article on their blog + Medium + social to 155k followers + newsletter to 20k); journalist-contact database; no free listing

requirements: Paid service only — packages for PR campaigns, press-release writing/distribution, media kits, journalist outreach
Campaign plan: $279/yr includes a 1,500-word feature on their blog + syndication
Journalist contact database is the DIY tier
This is a PR vendor, not a directory — 'catalog fit' is as a paid press channel
preparation: PR budget and a story worth pitching
workflow: Choose a package on press.farm/pricing or sign up for database access
For Campaign plan: their team writes/publishes the feature and distributes it
For database: search journalists by category and pitch yourself
watchFor: Paid placement — coverage on their own blog/Medium is bought, not earned
Claims of 6,000+ company customers and large follower counts are marketing
Real earned coverage still requires pitching actual journalists
countsAsLive: A purchased Pressfarm feature article or a PR campaign deliverable
unknowns: Full pricing tiers beyond the $279/yr Campaign plan
